scope: Reviewed Projects creation, management and automation subset; not all issues/Projects or six-source reconciliation.

rows.conflict: Repository link is discoverability; team link adds read access.
rows.requirement: Parameterize link type, owner and exact team/project IDs; require access-impact diff for grants.
rows.negative_test: Repository link must not imply read grant; team link must not be treated as harmless navigation.

rows.conflict: Removing one grant does not establish complete revocation; project access differs from repository content access.
rows.requirement: Reconcile owners/base/individual/team/public/internal grants and test intended reader against project and repository separately.
rows.negative_test: Removed grant with alternative access must not pass revocation; REDACTED must remain unknown.

rows.conflict: General admin capability is restricted by effective owner/enterprise policy and product feature scope.
rows.requirement: Parameterize owner type, EMU status, platform/version and governing visibility policy; exact approval before audience expansion.
rows.negative_test: Admin alone must not imply authority under owner-only restriction; internal must not be assumed universally available.

rows.conflict: Auto-add does not backfill on enable; auto-archive and optional creation import affect existing items.
rows.requirement: Describe existing-item impact per operation; snapshot candidate IDs and verify historical/future coverage separately.
rows.negative_test: Enabled auto-add cannot pass existing-item coverage; auto-archive enable must expose existing affected items.

rows.conflict: Age comparator examples conflict with last-period prose; activity includes metadata, not only code.
rows.requirement: Preserve ambiguity pending independent behavioral audit; parameterize age/timezone and all qualifying update events.
rows.negative_test: Boundary timestamps and recent metadata-only updates must not be silently classified from code inactivity.

rows.conflict: Archive retains quota and restore may encounter active automation; closure is not verified automation suspension.
rows.requirement: Separate archive/close/delete; record workflow state and bounded restoration verification before authorized destructive change.
rows.negative_test: Archive cannot claim freed quota; reopen/restore button cannot certify automation disabled or data restored.

rows.conflict: Optional drafts qualify no-items shorthand; copied configuration excludes auto-add and access links; template link is mutable context.
rows.requirement: Parameterize draft inclusion and destination; pin reviewed configuration identity and independently reconcile destination access/workflows.
rows.negative_test: Copy cannot inherit source permission assurance, auto-add or immutable revision from template link.

rows.conflict: Tutorial first-page queries and view TSV are not exhaustive backups or assessments.
rows.requirement: Traverse every supported connection, record redactions/types and denominators; verify backup restoration separately from view export.
rows.negative_test: 21st item/field and 11th assignee must not vanish from coverage; filtered TSV cannot certify full recoverability.

rows.conflict: Classic scopes, App permissions and repository token are distinct authority models.
rows.requirement: Use read-only default and explicit token-kind/project-owner permission matrix; do not mint/escalate credentials automatically.
rows.negative_test: Repository token or repository Projects permission cannot certify organization Projects write capability.

rows.conflict: Addition and field updates are separate; underlying issue mutations have broader scope and silent calls lack readback.
rows.requirement: Require exact operation diff, preconditions, per-step receipt, post-readback and recovery design; separate issue from project-item writes.
rows.negative_test: Failure after add or one field update must remain partial, not rolled back or PASS without evidence.

rows.conflict: Repository-local event workflow and built-in config do not prove estate coverage or effective behavior.
rows.requirement: Inventory intended repositories/events and test authorized success/denial/retry/recovery; record freshness and source-version applicability.
rows.negative_test: Workflow existence or Todo/Done status cannot certify acceptance, all events or native enforcement.

limitations: Requirements and negative tests are proposals, not implemented bindings or test receipts.
Reference identities do not prove policy equivalence or independent semantic completeness.
No rights clearance, native pilot or estate change.
